name: Cannabinol (CBN)
short: Human safety data are very limited: one single-night trial in 20 adults recorded 247 mild-to-moderate adverse events across all arms, including placebo. No interaction data were found.
text: Human safety data on cannabinol are very limited. In a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, single-night crossover trial in 20 adults with insomnia disorder, each given single oral doses of 30 mg and 300 mg cannabinol and placebo, 247 mild-to-moderate adverse events were recorded across the arms; the abstract does not break these down by arm, so it does not show whether they were more common with cannabinol than with placebo. The authors stated that larger, longer trials are warranted. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.

citations.label: Lavender et al., 2026, J Sleep Res
citations.title: Cannabinol for Acute Treatment of Insomnia Disorder in a Randomized Placebo-Controlled Crossover Trial.
